description: One reading order with the abstract of every term in it, in the order to read them. Give either `topic` or `terms`; giving neither returns the list of available reading orders.

terms.description: An explicit reading order instead of a curated one: term keys or display names, kept in the given order. This is the form a selection on alexjung.at/baukasten/ takes, whose URL fragment reads '#terms=llm,transformer'.

topic.description: Which reading order to return: a path id (e.g. 'llm', 'grundlagen', 'mathematik') or words from its title or its audience note. Matching is case-insensitive.

name: get_learning_path
title: Read one reading order
